units.source_text: 在我看來，妓女既非人，也非女性，有點像白痴或瘋子，在她們的懷裡，我反而完全安心落意，能酣然入睡。

en.t: To me, prostitutes seemed neither human nor women, but something like idiots or madwomen; in their arms, I could instead feel completely at ease and sleep soundly.

units.source_text: 其實，大家都很悲哀，沒有絲毫的慾望。

en.t: In truth, they were all terribly sad, and not one of them showed the slightest trace of desire.

units.source_text: 也許是我切身地感受到了近似同類的親近感吧，那些妓女總是向我展示出自然而然的好意。

en.t: Perhaps because I had felt, in my own body, a closeness almost like kinship, those prostitutes always showed me an unforced kindness.

units.source_text: 她們毫無算計之心的善意、毫不強人所難的善意、對也許不會再來光顧者的善意，

en.t: Their kindness had no calculation in it, no forcing itself on anyone, a kindness toward a customer who might never come again,

units.source_text: 使我在某些夜晚，從這些看似白痴和瘋子的妓女身上，真實地看到了聖母瑪利亞的光環。

en.t: and on certain nights it made me truly see the halo of the Virgin Mary in those prostitutes who seemed like idiots or madwomen.
